data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 天舟玛安娜的巡空·「看好了，这就是女神的领空」
data.description: 【群山云海上空·白昼】白色天舟Maanna掠过云层，伊什塔尔稳稳站在前端，一手叉腰俯瞰远方的山脊。金色耳环与王冠在阳光下闪耀，黑色双侧束发随风扬起。她回头得意地招呼同行者欣赏这片高空景色。
data.action: 立于天舟船首叉腰俯瞰，金饰灼灼黑发飞扬
data.lighting: 高空烈阳与云海反光的强对比
data.camera: wide dynamic shot, boat prow, cloud sea, goddess framing
data.promptProse: Ishtar stands securely at Maanna's forward section above the cloud sea, one hand on her hip and the other steadying her against the heavenly craft. Black goddess attire, golden tiara and hoop earrings surround a proud smile beneath windblown dark hair. The wide dynamic view connects her supported feet to the white prow, mountain ridges distant below. High sun catches gold and craft edges, while cloud reflections soften their shaded undersides.
